AUDIENCE & TESTABILITY:
API audience: ADVANCED/LOW-LEVEL
Harness testability: TESTABLE-WITH-LOW-LEVEL-CONSTRUCTION
Scoring recommendation: include only in advanced/internal bucket

ROOT CAUSE:
The documentation failed to mention that `ThumbnailMaker` uses a readiness tracker that requires all parameters to be set before calling `make()`. While `defaultResizer()` satisfies the resizer requirement, the image type requirement remains unset, causing `make()` to throw an `IllegalStateException: Maker not ready to make thumbnail`. The caller must also satisfy the image type requirement (e.g., by calling `defaultImageType()`) before execution.

CORRECT USAGE:
```java
net.coobird.thumbnailator.makers.FixedSizeThumbnailMaker maker = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.makers.FixedSizeThumbnailMaker(50, 50);
net.coobird.thumbnailator.makers.ThumbnailMaker returnedMaker = maker.defaultResizer();
returnedMaker.defaultImageType();

java.awt.image.BufferedImage result = returnedMaker.make(sourceImage);
```

REQUIRED TYPES & IMPORTS:
net.coobird.thumbnailator.makers.FixedSizeThumbnailMaker
net.coobird.thumbnailator.makers.ThumbnailMaker
java.awt.image.BufferedImage

DOC MUST SAY:
- `ThumbnailMaker` uses a readiness tracker and requires all configuration parameters to be set before calling `make()`.
- Calling `defaultResizer()` only satisfies the resizer requirement; callers must also satisfy the image type requirement (e.g., by calling `defaultImageType()`) to avoid an `IllegalStateException` during execution.
- `ThumbnailMaker` is an abstract class and must be instantiated via a concrete subclass like `FixedSizeThumbnailMaker`.
